title: Power Operations in Morava E-Theory of Flat Ring Spectra
summary: Let $E_n$ be Morava $E$-theory of height $n$. Let $R$ be a $p$-adically flat commutative ring spectrum. Then the Tate-valued Frobenius map endows $π_0 R$ with the structure of a $δ$-ring. On the other hand, we may form the $K(n)$-completed tensor product $L_{K(n)}(R \otimes E_n)$, which is a $K(n)$-local $E_n$-algebra. Then $π_0(L_{K(n)}(R \otimes E_n)) = LT_n \widehat{\otimes} π_0 R$ admits the structure of an algebra over the monad $\mathbb{T}(n)$ defined by Rezk.
